grades: Entering grades 10, 11 or 12 (Junior Camp is for entering grades 8 and 9)
pay_detail: Senior Camp is $1,600 and Junior Camp is $1,300. Partial scholarships are available and requested in the application.
notes: Call the College of Veterinary Medicine at 765-494-7607 with questions. Camp fees are all-inclusive for the hands-on in-residence camps.
name: Boiler Vet Camp (Senior Camp for grades 10 to 12)
org: Purdue University College of Veterinary Medicine
what_you_do: Seven days on campus to see what vet school and vet nursing are like. You do labs and demos. You also give hands-on care to a shelter dog, from checkup to ready for adoption.
who_can_apply: Students entering 10th, 11th or 12th grade for Senior Camp. The page says the minimum age for camp is 12. Past campers cannot repeat the same camp.
deadline_text: Senior Camp is scheduled for June 20 to 26, 2027 and Junior Camp for June 13 to 19, 2027. The page links to an application form but does not say when it opens.
how_to_apply: Online camper application on the Boiler Vet Camp page (not open yet). Ask for a scholarship inside the same application.
